overview.description: The Amplify Top 10 Space ETF (XWNG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of equities, which provides exposure to companies involved in the global space ecosystem. The fund also invests in derivative instruments, such as swaps and options contracts to gain exposure to this theme XWNG was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
